# Bundled VADER lexicon files

The files in this directory are redistributed, unmodified, from the original
VADER repository under the MIT License (see `LICENSE.txt`):

- `vader_lexicon.txt` — sentiment lexicon (~7,500 entries)
- `emoji_utf8_lexicon.txt` — emoji-to-description mapping (~3,500 entries)

Source: https://github.com/cjhutto/vaderSentiment (as distributed in
vaderSentiment 3.3.2)

Copyright (c) 2016 C.J. Hutto

If you use these lexicons, please cite:

> Hutto, C.J. & Gilbert, E.E. (2014). VADER: A Parsimonious Rule-based Model
> for Sentiment Analysis of Social Media Text. Eighth International Conference
> on Weblogs and Social Media (ICWSM-14). Ann Arbor, MI, June 2014.
